1: // Game: Asteroid Escape (concise implementation)
2: // Canvas element with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // ---- Game state -------------------------------------------------------
11:   const ship = {
12:     x: width / 2,
13:     y: height / 2,
14:     angle: 0, // radians
15:     vx: 0,
16:     vy: 0,
17:     radius: 12,
18:     thrust: 0.15,
19:     turnSpeed: 0.07,
20:     fuel: 100,
21:     fuelDrain: 0.02,
22:     shield: false,
23:     shieldTime: 0,
24:   };
25:   let asteroids = [];
26:   const maxAsteroids = 8;
27:   const score = { value: 0 };
28: 
29:   // ---- Input -----------------------------------------------------------
30:   const keys = {};
31:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
32:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
33: 
34:   // ---- Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
35:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
36:   const dist2 = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => (x1 - x2) ** 2 + (y1 - y2) ** 2;
37: 
38:   function spawnAsteroid() {
39:     const edge = Math.floor(rand(0, 4)); // 0 top,1 right,2 bottom,3 left
40:     let x, y, vx, vy;
41:     const speed = rand(0.5, 2);
42:     const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
43:     vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
44:     vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
45:     const size = rand(15, 40);
46:     switch (edge) {
47:       case 0: x = rand(0, width); y = -size; break;
48:       case 1: x = width + size; y = rand(0, height); break;
49:       case 2: x = rand(0, width); y = height + size; break;
50:       case 3: x = -size; y = rand(0, height); break;
51:     }
52:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius: size });
53:   }
54: 
55:   function updateShip(dt) {
56:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
57:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
58:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
59:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
60:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
61:     }
62:     // Apply inertia & fuel consumption
63:     ship.x += ship.vx * dt;
64:     ship.y += ship.vy * dt;
65:     ship.vx *= 0.99; ship.vy *= 0.99; // damping
66:     ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - ship.fuelDrain * dt);
67:     // Wrap around edges
68:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width;
69:     if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
70:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height;
71:     if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
72:     // Shield timer
73:     if (ship.shield) {
74:       ship.shieldTime -= dt;
75:       if (ship.shieldTime <= 0) ship.shield = false;
76:     }
77:   }
78: 
79:   function updateAsteroids(dt) {
80:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
81:       a.x += a.vx * dt;
82:       a.y += a.vy * dt;
83:       // Wrap
84:       if (a.x < -a.radius) a.x = width + a.radius;
85:       if (a.x > width + a.radius) a.x = -a.radius;
86:       if (a.y < -a.radius) a.y = height + a.radius;
87:       if (a.y > height + a.radius) a.y = -a.radius;
88:     });
89:     // Remove off‑screen (handled by wrap) and limit count
90:     while (asteroids.length < maxAsteroids) spawnAsteroid();
91:   }
92: 
93:   function checkCollisions() {
94:     for (const a of asteroids) {
95:       if (dist2(ship.x, ship.y, a.x, a.y) < (ship.radius + a.radius) ** 2) {
96:         if (ship.shield) {
97:           // destroy asteroid, no penalty
98:           const idx = asteroids.indexOf(a);
99:           if (idx > -1) asteroids.splice(idx, 1);
100:         } else {
101:           // Game over
102:           cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
103:           alert('Game Over! Score: ' + Math.floor(score.value));
104:           return true;
105:         }
106:       }
107:     }
108:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) {
109:       cancelAnimationFrame(frameId);
110:       alert('Out of fuel! Score: ' + Math.floor(score.value));
111:       return true;
112:     }
113:     return false;
114:   }
115: 
116:   function draw() {
117:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
118:     // ship
119:     ctx.save();
120:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
121:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
122:     ctx.beginPath();
123:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
124:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
125:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
126:     ctx.closePath();
127:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.shield ? 'cyan' : 'white';
128:     ctx.fill();
129:     ctx.restore();
130:     // asteroids
131:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
132:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
133:       ctx.beginPath();
134:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
135:       ctx.fill();
136:     });
137:     // UI
138:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
139:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
140:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + Math.floor(score.value), 10, 20);
141:     // fuel bar
142:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
143:     const fuelW = 100;
144:     ctx.fillRect(10, 30, fuelW * (ship.fuel / 100), 10);
145:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
146:     ctx.strokeRect(10, 30, fuelW, 10);
147:     // shield indicator
148:     if (ship.shield) {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
150:       ctx.fillText('Shield', 10, 55);
151:     }
152:   }
153: 
154:   let last = performance.now();
155:   let frameId;
156:   function loop(now) {
157:     const dt = (now - last) / 16; // approx 60fps normalised
158:     last = now;
159:     updateShip(dt);
160:     updateAsteroids(dt);
161:     score.value += dt * 0.1; // distance proxy
162:     if (checkCollisions()) return;
163:     draw();
164:     frameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
165:   }
166:   // Initialize asteroids
167:   while (asteroids.length < maxAsteroids) spawnAsteroid();
168:   frameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
169: })();

(End of file - total 169 lines)
